properties.content: Question: symptoms of covid in children Answer: Symptoms of COVID-19 in children can vary widely, and some may experience mild or no symptoms. Common symptoms include: Fever, Cough, Sore throat, Runny nose, Nasal congestion, Headache, Fatigue, Diarrhea, Nausea, and Vomiting. In some cases, children may develop more severe symptoms, such as: Difficulty breathing, Chest pain, Confusion, Seizures, and Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). It's important to note that these symptoms can also be caused by other illnesses, so it's essential to consult a healthcare professional for an accurate diagnosis.
properties.formattedContent:
Question: symptoms of covid in children

Answer: Symptoms of COVID-19 in children can vary widely, and some may experience mild or no symptoms. Common symptoms include:
Fever, Cough, Sore throat, Runny nose, Nasal congestion, Headache, Fatigue, Diarrhea, Nausea, and Vomiting.
In some cases, children may develop more severe symptoms, such as:
Difficulty breathing, Chest pain, Confusion, Seizures, and Multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C).
It's important to note that these symptoms can also be caused by other illnesses, so it's essential to consult a healthcare professional for an accurate diagnosis.
